mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as the key that unlocks the door to modernization, but the teacher holds the key to the door (Samuel 1996)."
Education is regarded as the key that unlocks the door to modernization, but the teacher holds the key to the door (Samuel 1996).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an appropriate stage for the teacher to clearly demonstrate how the materials are to be used during the lesson."
The presentation stage is an appropriate stage for the teacher to clearly demonstrate how the materials are to be used during the lesson.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the evaluation or what is sometimes referred to as the conclusion."
The fourth stage is the evaluation or what is sometimes referred to as the conclusion.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the use of internet for information gathering."
More importantly now is the use of internet for information gathering.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the most important media of information dissemination of our time."
The print is one of the most important media of information dissemination of our time.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important manpower needed to develop other manpower."
The teacher is the most important manpower needed to develop other manpower.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process of relating well with the pupils in the most suitable and appropriate language."
Effective communication is the process of relating well with the pupils in the most suitable and appropriate language.
fib: ______ refers to all the interactions that go on between individuals and groups in the class.
The social environment refers to all the interactions that go on between individuals and groups in the class.
______ is one of the greatest and most important responsibilities of a good teacher.
Record keeping is one of the greatest and most important responsibilities of a good teacher.
______ is the third condition for learning to take place.
Activity is the third condition for learning to take place.
______ refers to the intentions of government on what teacher education should be and how to go about it.
The National Policy on teacher education refers to the intentions of government on what teacher education should be and how to go about it.
______ is a voluntary thing which only the learners can decide whether to learn or not.
Learning is a voluntary thing which only the learners can decide whether to learn or not.
______ is the breaking down of the syllabus into weakly or daily learning experiences which the individual teacher would like the pupils to follow in a logical order.
The scheme of work is the breaking down of the syllabus into weakly or daily learning experiences which the individual teacher would like the pupils to follow in a logical order.
